ITEM 1 | Crispy, dark amber-brown strips with ruffled edges and rendered fat sheen, layered in overlapping curls, about 12 cm long and 2-3 cm wide, sitting across the center-top of the plate over the greens | 45
ITEM 2 | Pale off-white, soft, flaky-textured chunks with moist, slightly translucent edges and a fibrous, separable grain, piled in an irregular mound about 9 cm by 7 cm on the right side of the plate, roughly 1.5-2 cm thick | 150
ITEM 3 | Dark green wilted leafy greens with glossy, slightly moist surfaces and small stems, scattered in a loose patch about 7 cm by 5 cm at the lower-left and center of the plate | 35
ITEM 4 | Thin orange shreds of raw-looking carrot, bright orange with a slightly crisp, matchstick-like texture, spread in a small loose pile about 5 cm by 4 cm on the left beside the greens | 15
ITEM 5 | Bright green thin stalk-like pieces, slightly glossy and firm, about 6-7 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, lying across the greens near the lower center of the plate | 8
